_about: What evaluation/flutter_eval.py expects in samples/flutter_apk_probe (its source) and in the app packages that tools/build_flutter_apks.py builds from it (debug.apk, profile.apk, release.apk, release_obf.apk, release.aab). P items are the weaknesses planted in the probe (see samples/flutter_apk_probe/README.md); they are in every build. B items are properties of a build mode, expected only in the modes listed under 'modes'. An item is found in a scan when an open finding has its CWE (canonical id of sca.cwe), is in a file that matches one of the globs ('source' for the source scan, 'app' for a package; fnmatch, '*' also matches '/') and was reported by one of the 'rules' (fnmatch patterns matched against every rule id of the merged finding). An item without 'source' globs does not apply to the source scan.
